finding_1_usd_math.previous: risk/reward 600000/1400000 in the form; 78770 in the dashboard live feed (base-quantity formulas)
finding_1_usd_math.root_cause: NewTradeModal multiplied the price difference by the USD value; binance_client._recalculate_open_positions (dashboard live feed / WS open_positions) did the same and dropped qty_unit/record_mode
finding_1_usd_math.new_ui_result: form risk/reward = value x return (7.89/18.42 for the reported numbers); live feed = value x return (1.04) and keeps unit/label metadata

finding_2_auto_close.previous: ~2 minutes of 'waiting for a live quote' with no visible reason
finding_2_auto_close.root_cause: provider event timestamps can lead the local clock by fractions of a second; the eligibility check required 0 <= age, so fresh events were permanently rejected; ineligible observations were also counted as fetch failures (15->30->60->120 s backoff) and the reason was invisible
finding_2_auto_close.new_ui_result: the monitor retries stale events without backoff, shows the waiting reason/last error/next attempt, tolerates a bounded 5 s clock skew, and the automatic SL/TP close fired within ~3 s of arming (this retest: SL at 78204 vs stop 78209, value-based gross -0.0077 USD, single closure, external stays OPEN)
evidence: live log: monitor fetches 7-9 s cadence, closure event observed_at 2026-09-18T10:19:09.516Z

finding_3_simulation_label.previous: dashboard row lost the SIMULATION badge after live updates
finding_3_simulation_label.root_cause: the WS open_positions payload (no record_mode/qty_unit) replaced server rows in the store
finding_3_simulation_label.new_ui_result: live updates merge into server rows; the badge and USD unit survive (DOM test + live dashboard check)

finding_4_locale_key.root_cause: the key had no EN/TR/DE text
finding_4_locale_key.new_ui_result: translated text in create/edit; a content test asserts every dynamically composed verification key and monitor reason resolves in all three locales
